{{Short description|Indian mathematician (1948–2015)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=May 2018}}
{{Use Indian English|date=May 2018}}
'''Vinay Vithal Deodhar''' (3 December 1948 &ndash; 18 January 2015) was a [[Professor Emeritus]] in the Department of Mathematics at [[Indiana University]]. He worked in the area of [[algebraic group]]s and [[representation theory]].<ref name="iu">{{cite web
| url=http://www.math.indiana.edu/people/profile.phtml?id=deodhar
| title=Profile: Vinay Deodhar
| publisher=[[Indiana University]]
| access-date=27 September 2012
| archive-date=28 September 2012
| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120928221733/http://www.math.indiana.edu/people/profile.phtml?id=deodhar
| url-status=dead
}}</ref>

==Early life==
Deodhar was born in [[Mumbai]] (Bombay), [[India]] in 1948.<ref>{{cite news | 
url=https://math.indiana.edu/documents/newsletters/AlumniNewsletter2015.pdf |
title=Obituary - Vinay Deodhar | page=9 | work=Indiana University Department of Mathematics Alumni Newsletter | date=August 2015 | access-date=21 May 2018 }}</ref>

==Career==
Deodhar earned his Ph.D. from the [[University of Mumbai]] in 1974 for his work ''On Central Extensions of Rational Points of Algebraic Groups'' done under the supervision of [[M. S. Raghunathan]]. 

After his doctorate, he was invited to join the School of Mathematics of the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]]. Simultaneously he was a visiting scholar at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] (IAS) in [[Princeton]] during 1975-77 and then a visiting professor at the [[Australian National University]] in [[Canberra]]. In 1981 he was appointed to a professorship at [[Indiana University]], [[Bloomington, Indiana]], where he remained until his death in 2015. He spent a further period as a visiting scholar at the IAS in 1992-93.<ref name="ias">{{cite web
| url=http://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/vdeodhar01
| title=Community of Scholars Profile: Deodhar, Vinay Vithal
| publisher=[[Institute for Advanced Study]]
| access-date=27 September 2012
| archive-date=4 March 2016
| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304091917/https://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/vdeodhar01
| url-status=dead
}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.indiana.edu/~asnews/news-release/558.html|title=Professor Vinay Deodhar dies at 66|publisher=indiana.edu|date=5 February 2015}}</ref>
